implemented: Exact native MTP KV-only maintenance and last-row draft work with established fallback.
A bounded root fork with up to two branches, a total-node ceiling and staged chain verification; this is not an arbitrary tree verifier.
Cached proposal continuation after canonical MTP maintenance, unchanged target sampling and rejection/state invalidation.
Pruning uses compatible observed fresh-versus-cached rank-2 continuation costs and output, with eager branch cost paid on every parent cycle.
At least three compatible observations per side and a configured utility margin are required. Unknown/stale evidence uses sparse private probes and fallback.
Measured prior MAIN target expert occupancy/CPU work is kept separate from native MTP work. Resident expert CPU remains charged when SSD transfers are zero.
Independent tagged configuration/diagnostics and additive CLI/profile/benchmark controls; established public parameter layouts remain unchanged.
limitations: This ports exact scheduling concepts around existing Janas native MTP, not the complete published S2-MoE self-drafter.
Target expert gating/rerouting is approximate and excluded. Native MTP has separate expert weights and KV state; target/draft KV aliasing is excluded.
Immutable embedding/output weights were already shared; this is not claimed as a new saving.
Observed correction classes are cost predictions, not same-context counterfactuals or free future target routes.
The instrumented llm_s2 proof deliberately exercises branches; it does not establish production branch frequency or throughput.
All fresh and warm samples are retained. Fresh process is not cold SSD proof; physical drive bandwidth is not measured.
Execution-state holds and sampled AC/saver status do not control thermal state, clocks or unrelated scheduling effects.
40 tok/s remains the objective and 50 tok/s the stretch objective; neither is assumed from kernel or paper results.
